newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian call money market closed, gilts inactive.
newsitem.headline: Indian call money market closed, gilts inactive.

text.p: There were no trades in call money on Tuesday as the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) is closed for its half-yearly closing of accounts, dealers said.

"With the RBI not open for customer transactions today, there will be no clearing operations," said a dealer. "There will therefore be no call money trade today. Security transactions, if done today, will be for value tomorrow."
He said there had not been any trades in securities in early morning deals.
Indian call money ended Monday around 11 percent after touching a day's high of 11.5 percent.
